spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High density, functional control room grid. Generous internal padding for reading areas, tight gaps for data.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Cardless or 1px solid border (#27272a) with no shadow. Flat solid surfaces.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, dense content, and data. Optical alignment for icons.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to remove Vercel defaults. Strip shadows, use 1px borders, square or slightly rounded edges.
components.navigation: Sticky sidebar navigation for desktop, bottom bar or hamburger for mobile. Solid background (#09090b) with 1px right border.
components.chat_interface: Messages are distinct blocks. User: primary background (#3b82f6) with white text. AI: surface background (#18181b) with 1px border. Voice interface uses pulsing rings (framer-motion).
components.citations: Tiny, clickable monospace pills (#27272a background, text-xs) appended to AI responses.
components.document_upload: Dashed border area (#27272a) with hover state changing border to primary (#3b82f6) and subtle background tint.
components.data_tables: Shadcn tables. No zebra striping, just 1px bottom borders for rows. Monospace fonts for numbers/dates.
components.analytics_charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts). Use primary (#3b82f6) and muted zinc (#27272a) for data lines/bars. No grid lines except subtle y-axis.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly change text color and background on hover. Example: hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white
motion_and_interactions.animations: Micro-interactions for feedback. Pulsing effect for voice recording state. Staggered fade-up for list items/chat messages.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Focus states must have high contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-zinc-950).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='voice-record-btn').

media.icons: lucide-react for standard UI, @phosphor-icons/react for rich dashboard icons.

image_urls.description: Dark obsidian geometric architecture, excellent for a subtle, professional login background overlay or hero banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required font dependencies: google fonts for Outfit, Manrope, JetBrains Mono.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the specified colors (zinc scale for neutrals, blue scale for primary) and border radius (md).
Build the dashboard layout with a persistent sidebar.
Implement the Chat View (default route): text input, voice record button with pulsing animation, message history with citation pills.
Implement Admin View: Document upload zone (drag & drop), indexing status table, role management, and simple analytics charts using recharts.
Ensure the entire app is wrapped in the dark mode class (e.g., `<html className='dark'>`).
All cards/containers should use `bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800` rather than shadows.
DO NOT use Inter font anywhere. Stick strictly to the typography scales defined.
